headline: A Qwen looping study reports gains only in its smallest post-training regime
summary: The authors compare post-training transformer layer loops in Qwen3/Qwen3.5 models from 0.8B to 9B parameters against identically trained unlooped twins and unlooped equal-FLOP controls. In the reported short full-fine-tuning condition, the 0.8B loop improves a paired GSM8K/MATH macro score by 4.1 points, while the main 4B and 9B comparisons show no statistically significant gain. The paper separately evaluates training-free loop conversions: its Qwen3-8B loop has modest or non-significant task gains at about 1.8x measured decoding time, while selected Qwen3-14B results differ. These are author-reported results from specific Qwen recipes and task sets, not evidence about recurrence learned during large-scale pretraining or production workloads.
